title: Add crates.io publish metadata to proxide-confind, proxide-rotlib, proxide-frag, proxide-parallel-rt
description: Each of the 4 new publishable crates is missing: repository.workspace, homepage.workspace, categories, and [package.metadata.docs.rs]. Their internal path deps use relative ../proxide-X paths instead of workspace = true + version, which will fail cargo publish. Fix all 4 crates: inherit workspace fields, add categories, add docs.rs feature configs (exclude hdf5/fetching where applicable), and convert path deps to workspace = true.

title: Add missing license field to proxide-parallel-rt Cargo.toml
description: proxide-parallel-rt has no license field in its Cargo.toml — cargo package validation will fail. Add license.workspace = true to [package]. Must land before #1401.

title: Mark proxide-wasm publish = false
description: proxide-wasm is a cdylib wasm-bindgen package distributed via wasm-pack/npm — not a crates.io crate. Add publish = false to its [package] section and verify it is absent from the publish-crates CI job.

title: Update publish-crates and verify-crates CI jobs for new crates
description: The publish-crates job covers only the original 7 crates. Add proxide-parallel-rt (Tier 1), proxide-rotlib and proxide-frag (Tier 3), and proxide-confind (Tier 4, depends on rotlib) to both verify-crates (--dry-run) and publish-crates. proxide-wasm is excluded via publish=false.

title: Fix CI README copy step to not clobber existing per-crate READMEs
description: The verify-crates and publish-crates jobs use cp README.md unconditionally. proxide-rotlib and proxide-wasm already have per-crate READMEs. Change to cp -n (no-clobber).

title: Migrate new crate path deps from relative paths to workspace = true
description: proxide-confind, proxide-rotlib, proxide-frag, and proxide-wasm use relative path deps instead of workspace = true. Migrate each to the workspace dep entry so cargo publish can resolve them via crates.io.

title: Triage 8 stale backlog branches
description: Branches backlog-799, backlog-814, backlog-815, backlog-816, backlog-817, backlog-818, backlog-820, backlog-976 are 201+ commits behind main. Evaluate each: if work is on main, delete; if deferred scope, open a fresh item and delete; if still relevant, rebase.

title: Write per-crate README.md for all publishable crates
description: CI currently copies root README.md as a workaround via cp -n. Write a dedicated README.md for each of the 11 crates that lack one: proxide-units, proxide-core, proxide-geometry, proxide-gaff, proxide-io, proxide-physics, proxide_rs, proxide_fixer, proxide-confind, proxide-frag, proxide-parallel-rt. Each README should describe: crate purpose in 2-3 sentences, key public types/functions, a minimal usage example, feature flags, and a link back to the workspace repo. proxide-rotlib and proxide-wasm already have per-crate READMEs. Once all crates have their own README, remove the cp -n fallback from verify-crates and publish-crates CI steps.
